entities.name: PMID:27515254
observations: Bartholomé et al. (2016), “Performance of genomic prediction within and across generations in maritime pine,” BMC Genomics; DOI:10.1186/s12864-016-2879-8.

entities.name: Maritime pine cross-generation accuracy
observations: In maritime pine G0/G1-to-G2 progeny validation for circumference, height, and stem straightness, prediction accuracy ranged 0.70–0.85; pedigree-based ABLUP was similar to or better than marker models.

entities.name: Relatedness affects within-generation accuracy
observations: Within-generation validation accuracy differed by a mean 0.17 between low- and high-relatedness validation scenarios; including progenitors reduced the difference to 0.03.
